decision: The bounded one-sided HYPE evaluation window is a measured market-state outcome rather than a one-sided implementation defect. The v52 route is configured and tested for both sides, and a fresh eligible opposite alignment-v2 intent closes an open position before any later re-entry.
problem_restatement: Determine whether zero observed HYPE short evaluations indicate a broken bidirectional route and verify that the deployed route has a causal signal exit before its maximum-hold fallback.

bounded_live_evidence.selection_contract: run_id plus event_type=intent_routing plus nested evaluation strategy_id; canonical sorted-key compact JSON line per selected evaluation

deployed_contract.opposite_signal_exit: a fresh eligible opposite alignment-v2 entry intent is converted by the portfolio router into a close action; no same-cycle reversal is permitted
deployed_contract.provider_recipe_exit_interpretation: The HYPE route does not consume provider exit_sides telemetry. Its signal exit is the portfolio router's opposite eligible strategy intent, which is a separate causal path.

validated_behaviors: alignment-v2 emits both long and short intents when the respective causal side is aligned
the exact v52 capability converts a fresh opposite HYPE intent into one close action
the router never reverses or re-enters on that same decision cycle
the live runner enforces the same opposite-intent close ordering
the regime-supported soft deadline is journaled and remains bounded by the hard deadline

recommendation.recommendation: Keep the HYPE alignment-v2 entry and exit contract unchanged while collecting the first eligible lifecycle and genuine short-side structural window.
recommendation.why_now: The live run has accumulated enough exact evaluations to distinguish current structural exposure from a missing bidirectional code path, but no eligible lifecycle exists to measure economics.
recommendation.evidence_reviewed: A bounded and hashed 166-evaluation live prefix, the exact v52 profile, entry provider, portfolio router, live runner, and six focused integration tests.
recommendation.observed_problem_or_opportunity: All observed HYPE evaluations were long-side because every structural direction was long. No eligible intent, fill, or closed v52 lifecycle occurred.
recommendation.applicable_market_regime: Predominantly 1m/5m range behavior with 151 TREND_UP and 15 RANGE 15m contexts during the bounded prefix.
recommendation.alternatives_considered: Treat zero short evaluations as a route defect, force symmetric long and short evaluations each minute, enable a generic provider-recipe exit, add a fixed take-profit, or retain the causal side and router exit contract.
recommendation.expected_upside: Avoid manufacturing counter-regime short trades while preserving a verified opposite-signal exit and bounded maximum hold.
recommendation.main_risks_and_failure_modes: The short side remains unobserved in this v52 run, an opposite signal may arrive after profit has already retraced, and no fixed target or trailing stop exists.
recommendation.validation_completed: Side and structural direction reconciled row-for-row with zero mismatches; both-side entry routing and opposite-intent close ordering passed focused tests.
recommendation.validation_still_required: At least one eligible and filled HYPE lifecycle per side, exact live fees and slippage, stop behavior, opposite-signal timing, and completed exit economics with largest-winner sensitivity.
recommendation.success_metrics: A future short structural state produces a short evaluation, every eligible intent has an action or explicit withholding, and any opposite eligible intent while open produces one close without same-cycle reversal.
recommendation.failure_or_rollback_triggers: A short structural direction labeled long, an eligible opposite intent that does not close, an unprotected open position, a hard deadline breach, or live behavior inconsistent with the hashed contract.
recommendation.confidence_level: high on bidirectional implementation and bounded current-regime attribution; low on strategy profitability and future exit quality because v52 has zero resolved lifecycles

falsifier: Update this diagnosis when HYPE enters a short structural state, the first eligible or filled v52 event occurs, or actual opposite-signal and maximum-hold behavior contradicts the tested contract.
